name: feedgrab-desktop
description: Commercial desktop GUI client for feedgrab.
author: iBigQiang

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.pack:dev: npm run build && npm run runtime:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-windows.ps1 -Target portable -SkipRuntimeBuild
scripts.pack:user: npm run build && npm run runtime:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-windows.ps1 -Target nsis -SkipRuntimeBuild
scripts.pack:all: npm run build && npm run runtime:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-windows.ps1 -Target all -SkipRuntimeBuild
